facts.fact: Matoto's communal education director says the unique pupil matricule began in 2022 at collège and lycée and that the minister has extended it to primary, the registration running nationwide from 5 to 25 March 2026; pre-school is to follow in later years.

Each pupil is given one matricule in a registration operation of 5 to 25 March 2026 for which public and private school heads were mobilised, after which transfers between schools are detected automatically; the article does not say who keys the record.
The registration of primary pupils under the unique matricule was launched in Matoto on 5 March 2026, to run nationwide until 25 March 2026, extending a measure applied to secondary since 2022.
The primary registration is described as covering the whole national territory from 5 to 25 March 2026, public and private schools alike; no number or share of primary schools is given.
The Ministry of Pre-University Education instituted the unique matricule, within a digitalisation run by its Direction Générale des Examens et Contrôle Scolaire, as reported on 5 March 2026.

systems.tiers: collège and lycée since 2022; primary from March 2026; public and private schools nationwide
